title: Patchwork Water: Urban Growth, Strained Water Networks, and Household Water Burdens in the Horn of Africa
Targeting subsidies through price menus: Menu design and evidence from clean fuels
Air Pollution and Mental Health: Evidence from China
abstract: We estimate the short-run effect of air pollution on mental illness. Using the China Family Panel Studies covering 12,615 urban residents during 2014-2015, we find a significantly positive effect of air pollution-instrumented by thermal inversions—on mental illness measured by the Kessler Psychological Distress Scale. Specifically, a 1 SD (18.04 mu-g/m3) increase in PM2.5 concentrations over a month increases the probability of having a score value associated with severe mental illness by 7.58 percentage points, or 0.37 SD. We find suggestive evidence that indirect channels—like reduced exercise and physical health—play a role in the effect.
abstract_zh: 我们估计了空气污染对精神疾病的短期影响。利用覆盖2014至2015年间12,615名城市居民的中国家庭追踪调查（CFPS）数据，我们发现，以逆温层（thermal inversions）作为工具变量的空气污染，对以凯斯勒心理痛苦量表（Kessler Psychological Distress Scale）衡量的精神疾病有显著的正向影响。具体而言，PM2.5浓度在一个月内增加1个标准差（18.04 μg/m³），会使得量表得分达到与重度精神疾病相关取值的概率提高7.58个百分点，即0.37个标准差。我们发现，间接渠道（如运动减少和身体健康状况下降）在该效应中可能发挥了作用，但证据仅具启示性。

title: Migration and the Environment: A Look Across Perspectives
Scale Effects of Rapid Transit and Automobile Adoption
The Effect of Pollution on Migration: Evidence from China
abstract: This paper looks at the effects of air pollution on migration in China using changes in the average strength of thermal inversions over five-year periods as a source of exogenous variation for medium-run air pollution levels. Our findings suggest that air pollution is responsible for large changes in inflows and outflows of migration in China. Specifically, we find that a 10 percent increase in air pollution, holding everything else constant, is capable of reducing population through net out migration by about 2.8 percent in a given county. We find that these inflows are primarily driven by well-educated people at the beginning of their professional careers, leading to substantial changes in the sociodemographic composition of the population and labor force of Chinese counties. We also find strong gender asymmetries in the response of mid-age adults that suggests families are splitting across counties to protect vulnerable members of the household. Our results are robust to different specifications, including a spatial lag model that accounts for localized migration spillovers and spatially correlated pollution shocks.
abstract_zh: 本文利用五年期间逆温层平均强度的变化作为中期空气污染水平的外生变异来源，考察了空气污染对中国人口迁移的影响。我们的研究结果表明，空气污染是导致中国人口迁入与迁出大幅变动的重要原因。具体而言，在其他条件不变的情况下，空气污染每增加10%，将使一个县的人口因净迁出而减少约2.8%。我们发现，这种迁入主要由职业生涯刚起步的高学历人群所驱动，从而导致中国各县人口与劳动力的社会人口结构发生重大变化。我们还发现，中年成年人的反应存在显著的性别不对称，这表明家庭为了保护其中的脆弱成员，正在跨县分散居住。我们的结果在不同设定下均稳健，包括能够刻画局部迁移溢出效应及空间相关污染冲击的空间滞后模型。

title: The Power of Perception: Limitations of Information in Reducing Air Pollution Exposure
abstract: We conduct a randomized controlled trial in Mexico City to determine willingness to pay (WTP) for SMS air quality alerts and to study the effects of air quality alerts, reminders, and a reusable N95 mask on air pollution information and avoidance behavior. At baseline, we elicit WTP for the alerts service after revealing whether the household will receive an N95 mask and participant compensation, but before revealing whether they will receive alert or reminder services. While we observe no significant impact of mask provision on WTP, higher compensation increases WTP, suggesting a possible cash-on-hand constraint. The perception of high pollution days prior to the survey is positively correlated with WTP, but the presence of actual high pollution days is not correlated with WTP. Follow-up survey data demonstrate that the alerts treatment increases reporting of receiving air pollution information via SMS, a high pollution day in the past week, and staying indoors on the most recent perceived high pollution day. However, we observe no significant effect on the ability to correctly identify which specific days had high pollution. Similarly, households that received an N95 mask are more likely to report utilizing a mask with filter in the past two weeks, but we observe no effect on using a filter mask on the specific days with high particulate matter. Although we nd that air quality alerts increased the salience of air quality and avoidance behavior, these results illustrate the difficulty that information treatments face in overcoming perceptions to effectively reduce exposure to air pollution.
abstract_zh: 我们在墨西哥城开展了一项随机对照试验，以确定居民对短信空气质量预警的支付意愿（WTP），并研究空气质量预警、提醒以及可重复使用的N95口罩对空气污染信息及回避行为的影响。在基线阶段，我们在告知家庭是否会获得N95口罩及参与补偿之后，但在告知其是否会获得预警或提醒服务之前，测量其对预警服务的支付意愿。我们观察到，口罩的提供对支付意愿没有显著影响，但更高的补偿会提高支付意愿，这表明可能存在现金持有约束。调查前对高污染日的感知与支付意愿呈正相关，但实际高污染日的出现与支付意愿并不相关。后续调查数据显示，预警处理增加了居民通过短信接收空气污染信息的报告、过去一周出现高污染日的报告，以及在最近一次感知到的高污染日留在室内的行为。然而，我们未观察到其在正确识别哪些具体日期为高污染日方面有显著效果。同样，收到口罩的家庭更有可能报告在过去两周使用过带过滤功能的口罩，但在颗粒物浓度较高的具体日期，我们未观察到使用过滤口罩方面的效果。尽管我们发现，空气质量预警提高了人们对空气质量的关注度以及回避行为，这些结果说明，信息干预在克服认知障碍以有效减少空气污染暴露方面面临困难。

title: Technology Adoption under Uncertainty: Take-up and Subsequent Investment in Zambia
The Distribution of Environmental Damages
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: Most regulations designed to reduce environmental externalities impose costs on individuals and firms. An active body of research has explored how these costs are disproportionately born by different sectors of the economy and/or across different groups of individuals. However, much less is known about the distributional characteristics of the environmental benefits created by these policies, or conversely, the differences in environmental damages associated with existing environmental externalities. We review this burgeoning literature and develop a simple and general framework for focusing future empirical investigations. We apply our framework to findings related to the economic impact of air pollution, deforestation, and climate, highlighting important areas for future research. A recurring challenge to understanding the distributional effects of environmental damages is distinguishing between cases where (i) populations are exposed to different levels or changes in an environmental good, and (ii) where an incremental change in the environment may have very different implications for some populations. In the latter case, it is often difficult to empirically identify the underlying sources of heterogeneity in marginal damages, as damages may stem from either non-linear and/or heterogeneous damage functions. Nonetheless, understanding the determinants of heterogeneity in environmental benefits and damages is crucial for welfare analysis and policy design.
abstract_zh: 大多数旨在减少环境外部性的监管都会给个人和企业带来成本。一个活跃的研究领域已探讨了这些成本如何不成比例地由经济中的不同部门和/或不同群体个体承担。然而，人们对这些政策所创造的环境效益的分配特征，或者反过来说，与现有环境外部性相关的环境损害差异，了解要少得多。我们回顾了这一迅速发展的文献，并构建了一个简单而通用的框架，以指导未来的实证研究。我们将该框架应用于与空气污染、森林砍伐和气候相关的经济影响研究结果，并突出了未来研究的重要领域。理解环境损害分配效应的一个反复出现的挑战，在于区分以下两种情形：（i）人口所暴露的环境要素水平或其变化不同；以及（ii）环境的增量变化对某些人口可能具有截然不同的含义。在后一种情形中，由于损害可能源于非线性和/或异质性的损害函数，要通过实证方法识别边际损害异质性的根本来源，往往十分困难。尽管如此，理解环境效益与损害异质性的决定因素，对于福利分析和政策设计至关重要。

title: Particulate matter and labor supply: The role of caregiving and non-linearities
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: This paper examines the effect of air pollution on labor supply in Lima, Peru. It focuses on fine particulate matter (PM2.5), an important pollutant for health according to the medical literature, and shows that moderate levels of pollution reduce hours worked for working adults. The research design takes advantage of rich household panel data in labor outcomes to address omitted variables and allows investigation of whether the response to air pollution is non-linear. The analysis finds that the effect of moderate pollution levels on hours worked is concentrated among households with susceptible dependents, that is small children and elderly adults, while the highest concentrations affect all households. This suggests that caregiving is likely a mechanism linking air pollution to labor supply at moderate levels. Further evidence of this mechanism is provided using DHS data on children morbidity for the same time period. Finally, no evidence is found of intra-household attenuation behavior. For instance, there is no re-allocation of labor across household members, and earnings decrease with air pollution.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了秘鲁利马空气污染对劳动供给的影响。文章聚焦于细颗粒物（PM2.5）——医学文献认为其对健康具有重要影响的一种污染物——并表明，中等水平的污染会减少在职成年人的工作时长。研究设计利用了丰富的家庭面板数据中的劳动结果，以应对遗漏变量问题，并允许检验对空气污染的反应是否具有非线性。分析发现，中等污染水平对工作时长的影响集中于拥有易感受抚养人（即幼儿和老年人）的家庭，而最高浓度的污染则影响所有家庭。这表明，在中等污染水平下，照护责任很可能是连接空气污染与劳动供给的机制。我们利用同一时期的DHS儿童发病率数据，为该机制提供了进一步证据。最后，我们未发现家庭内部存在缓解行为的证据。例如，劳动力并未在家庭成员之间重新配置，而且收入随空气污染上升而下降。

title: Does the Effect of Pollution on Infant Mortality Differ Between Developing and Developed Countries? Evidence from Mexico City
abstract: Much of what we know about the marginal effect of pollution on infant mortality is derived from developed country data. However, given the lower levels of air pollution in developed countries, these estimates may not be externally valid to the developing country context if there is a nonlinear dose relationship between pollution and mortality or if the costs of avoidance behavior differs considerably between the two contexts. In this paper, we estimate the relationship between pollution and infant mortality using data from Mexico. We find that an increase of 1 parts per billion in carbon monoxide (CO) over the last week results in 0.0032 deaths per 100,000 births, while a 1 g/m3 increase in particulate matter (PM10) results in 0.24 infant deaths per 100,000 births. Our estimates for PM10 tend to be similar (or even smaller) than the U.S. estimates, while our findings on CO tend to be larger than those derived from the U.S. context. We provide suggestive evidence that a non-linearity in the relationship between CO and health explains this difference.
abstract_zh: 我们关于污染对婴儿死亡率边际效应的大部分认识，都源自发达国家的数据。然而，鉴于发达国家的空气污染水平较低，如果污染与死亡率之间存在非线性剂量关系，或者两种情境下的规避行为成本存在显著差异，这些估计可能并不适用于发展中国家的情形。本文利用墨西哥的数据，估计了污染与婴儿死亡率之间的关系。我们发现，过去一周一氧化碳（CO）增加百万分之一（ppb），每10万例出生中会增加0.0032例死亡；而颗粒物（PM10）增加1微克每立方米，每10万例出生中会增加0.24例婴儿死亡。我们对PM10的估计往往与美国的估计相近（甚至更小），而我们对一氧化碳的发现则往往大于来自美国背景的估计。我们提供了一些提示性证据，表明一氧化碳与健康之间关系的非线性解释了这一差异。

title: Implications of Climate Change for Children in Developing Countries
abstract: Climate change may be particularly dangerous for children in developing countries. Even today, many developing countries experience a disproportionate share of extreme weather, and they are predicted to suffer disproportionately from the effects of climate change in the future. Moreover, developing countries often have limited social safety nets, widespread poverty, fragile health care systems, and weak governmental institutions, making it harder for them to adapt or respond to climate change. And the fact that many developing countries have high birth rates and high ratios of children to adults (known as high dependency ratios) means that proportionately more children are at risk there than in the developed world. In this article, Rema Hanna and Paulina Oliva delve into climate change’s likely implications for children in developing countries. Such children already face severe challenges, which climate change will likely exacerbate. In particular, most people in developing countries still depend primarily on agriculture as a source of income, and so anything that reduces crop yields—such as excessive heat or rain—is likely to directly threaten the livelihoods of developing-country families and their ability to feed their children. Poor nutrition and economic disruption are likely to lower children’s scholastic achievement or even keep them out of school altogether. Children in developing countries also face more-severe threats from both air and water pollution; from infectious and parasitic diseases carried by insects or contaminated water; and from possible displacement, migration, and violence triggered by climate change. How can we temper the threat to children in developing countries? Hanna and Oliva write that we should design and fund policies to shield children in developing nations from the harm caused by climate change. Such policies might include developing new technologies, inventing more-weather-resistant crops, improving access to clean water, increasing foreign aid during disasters, and offering more assistance to help poor countries expand their safety net programs.
abstract_zh: 气候变化对发展中国家的儿童可能尤为危险。即便在今天，许多发展中国家所遭受的极端天气也远超其应有的比例，并且预计未来它们在气候变化影响下也将承受不成比例的损失。此外，发展中国家往往社会安全网有限、贫困普遍、医疗卫生体系脆弱、政府机构薄弱，这使它们更难适应或应对气候变化。而且，许多发展中国家的出生率较高，儿童与成年人的比例（即所谓的高抚养比）也较高，这意味着与发达国家相比，那里面临风险的儿童比例更高。在本文中，Rema Hanna和Paulina Oliva深入探讨了气候变化对发展中国家儿童可能产生的影响。这些儿童本已面临严峻挑战，而气候变化很可能会加剧这些挑战。特别是，发展中国家的大多数人仍主要依靠农业获取收入，因此，任何降低作物产量的因素——例如过度的高温或降雨——都很可能直接威胁到发展中国家家庭的生计及其养育子女的能力。营养不良和经济动荡很可能降低儿童的学业成绩，甚至使他们完全失学。发展中国家的儿童还面临着更为严重的空气和水污染威胁，面临由昆虫或受污染水源传播的传染病和寄生虫病威胁，并且可能因气候变化而被迫流离失所、迁徙或遭受暴力。我们如何才能减轻气候变化对发展中国家儿童的威胁？Hanna和Oliva写道，我们应当设计并资助相关政策，保护发展中国家的儿童免受气候变化所造成的伤害。此类政策可能包括：研发新技术、培育更能抵御天气变化的作物、改善清洁水的供应、在灾害期间增加对外援助，以及为帮助贫困国家扩展其社会安全网项目提供更多援助。

title: Environmental Regulation and Corruption: Automobile Emissions in Mexico City
Moving up the Energy Ladder: The Effect of an Increase in Economic Well-being on the Fuel Consumption Choices of the Poor in India
venue: American Economic Review: Papers and Proceedings
abstract: Rising household wealth may potentially impact both total fuel consumption and fuel-type composition, resulting in significant health and environmental implications. Using data from a field experiment in India, we explore the effects of a transfer program that provided poor, rural households with greater levels of assets and cash. Total fuel consumption rose as a result of the transfers. Households shifted from using electricity rather than kerosene as their primary form of light, but total kerosene consumption also rose. In contrast, we did not observe a shift to cleaner cooking fuels.
abstract_zh: 家庭财富的增长可能同时影响燃料总消费量与燃料类型结构，进而产生重大的健康与环境后果。利用印度一项实地实验的数据，我们考察了一项向贫困农村家庭提供更多资产和现金的转移支付计划的效应。转移支付导致燃料总消费上升。家庭的主要照明方式由煤油转向电力，但煤油的总消费量也有所上升。与此相反，我们并未观察到家庭向更清洁的炊事燃料转变。

title: The Effect of Pollution on Labor Supply: Evidence from a Natural Experiment in Mexico City
The Impact of Inspections on Plant-Level Air Emissions
venue: The B.E. Journal of Economic Analysis & Policy
abstract: Each year, the United States conducts approximately 20,000 inspections of manufacturing plants under the Clean Air Act. This paper compiles a panel dataset on plant-level inspections, fines, and emissions to understand whether these inspections actually reduce air emissions. We find plants reduce air emissions by fifteen percent, on average, following an inspection under the Clean Air Act. Plants that belong to industries that typically have low abatement costs respond more strongly to an inspection than those who belong to industries with high abatement costs.
abstract_zh: 每年，美国依据《清洁空气法》对制造工厂进行大约2万次检查。本文汇编了一份关于工厂层面检查、罚款与排放的面板数据集，以了解这些检查是否确实减少了空气排放。我们发现，根据《清洁空气法》进行检查之后，工厂的空气排放平均减少了15%。减排成本通常较低的行业中的工厂，相比减排成本较高行业中的工厂，对检查的反应更为强烈。
